name: Giles, Giles and Fripp
description: '''Giles, Giles and Fripp''' were an English music group, formed in [[Bournemouth]], [[Dorset]] in August 1967. It featured brothers [[Michael Giles]] on drums and vocals and [[Peter Giles (musician)|Peter Giles]] on bass guitar and vocals, and [[Robert Fripp]] on guitar. The band's music showed an eclectic mix of [[pop music|pop]], [[psychedelic rock]], [[Folk music|folk]], [[jazz]], and [[Classical music|classical]] influences. Music historian Vernon Joynson retrospectively likened their music to [[freakbeat]] and [[sunshine pop]]. The group eventually evolved into pioneering [[progressive rock]] band [[King Crimson]].
